instruction: Determine which month had the highest total sales across all sales representatives and highlight that month's column header in yellow.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding the month with highest total sales and highlighting its header. Verified with Python: calculated monthly totals across all reps - Jan=4852, Feb=4587, Mar=3943, Apr=3857, May=4677, Jun=4243. January (column B) has the highest total of 4852. Evaluator checks if cell B1 (Jan header) has highlighting applied. Custom getter checks header row cells for fill color, metric verifies it's the correct month.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage: Evaluator checks all requirements - correct month identification AND yellow color highlighting
Getter correctly extracts color RGB value from highlighted cell (xlsx.py:52) in addition to column and month name
Metric includes proper yellow color validation via _is_yellow_color() helper function (xlsx.py:6-39)
Yellow color detection logic is sound: requires R>200, G>200, B<min(R,G), which correctly identifies yellow variants (FFFF00, FFFF99, FFFFE0) while rejecting other colors
Expected values are correct: Jan has highest total sales (4852), column B is correct
Metric correctly receives rules dict directly as expected parameter (no 'rules' key wrapping)
Data flow is correct: getter extracts state -> metric validates both month/column AND color -> returns 1.0 only if both pass
Postconfig appropriately saves file with Ctrl+S before verification to ensure fresh state
